label: Orchestrators
descriptionMd: Control planes and runtimes that coordinate agents, tasks, state, governance, and human review.
definitionMd: Orchestrators coordinate agent work across multiple runs, roles, workers, or workflows.
scopeMd: This category covers coordination rather than a single agent implementation.
inclusionMd: Include products that assign, schedule, route, or supervise agent work.
exclusionMd: Exclude generic workflow schedulers with no material agent coordination layer.
selectionGuideMd: Compare supported runtimes, state, failure handling, budgets, and approvals.

sources.title: Paperclip repository
sources.claim: The repository documents an orchestration system for teams of AI agents.
